import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
import torch.nn.functional as F
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab

def run(rank, ws):
    os.environ["MASTER_ADDR"]="127.0.0.1"; os.environ["MASTER_PORT"]=str(29511+ws)
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=128, hidden_size=64, intermediate_size=128, num_hidden_layers=5,
                      num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2, max_position_embeddings=64)
    model = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); ref = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); ref.load_state_dict(model.state_dict())
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1)
    ins = [torch.randint(0,128,(2,16),generator=g) for _ in range(4)]
    tg = [torch.randint(0,128,(2,16),generator=g) for _ in range(4)]
    loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(model, ins, tg, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
    rl = 0
    for i,t in zip(ins,tg):
        l = F.cross_entropy(ref(i).logits.reshape(-1,128), t.reshape(-1))/4; l.backward(); rl += l.item()
    if rank==ws-1: print("loss", loss, rl)
    mx=0; n=0
    for (k,p),(_,q) in zip(model.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
        if p.grad is not None:
            n+=1; mx=max(mx,(p.grad-q.grad).abs().max().item())
    print(rank, "params with grad", n, "maxdiff", mx)
    dist.destroy_process_group()

if __name__=="__main__":
    for ws in (1,2):
        mp.spawn(run, args=(ws,), nprocs=ws)
